draft.summary: The learner verbally stated the place value of highlighted digits in four-digit numbers without a recorded prior correction across two items.
draft.teachingImplication: Continue offering opportunities to say the value of highlighted digits in multi-digit numbers under similar conditions.
draft.checkNext: Present a four-digit number with a single highlighted digit in the tens or hundreds place and ask the learner to say its value.

draft.summary: In the say_value phase, the learner successfully stated the value of a highlighted digit after receiving a recorded correction on two separate items.
draft.teachingImplication: Continue offering immediate feedback or modeling when a digit's face value is named instead of its place value, reinforcing the distinction between digit name and value.
draft.checkNext: Present a four-digit number with one digit highlighted, such as the 3 in 4381, and ask the learner to state the value of that digit without initial prompting.
